name: @humanities/greek-conversion
description: Bidirectional conversion between Greek, Beta Code, and transliteration, with standards-based presets and information-loss diagnostics.
author: Antoine Boquet

scripts.check: npm run check:format && npm run check:lint && npm run check:types && npm run check:docs
scripts.check:types: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p web
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check_api_docs.ts && node scripts/check_readme.ts && node scripts/generate_preset_docs.ts --check && node scripts/generate_option_relevance.ts --check && node scripts/check_metadata.ts
scripts.npm:check: npm run npm:build && node scripts/npm_smoke.mjs && node scripts/npm_types_smoke.mjs && npm pack ./npm --dry-run
